_source: USCIS, Form I-918 page, 'Where to File' (uscis.gov/i-918), page last updated 06/05/2026, read 2026-10-02: 'Mail your I-918 to the filing location based on where you live.' Every box is 'Attn: 1367' (the 8 U.S.C. 1367 confidentiality unit). The same four lockboxes take a Form I-192 filed with a U petition (uscis.gov/i-192 -> 'Filing Addresses for Certain Forms Filed in Connection With a VAWA, T, or U Visa Application/Petition', uscis.gov/Certain-VAWA-T-U-Filing-Locations, updated 02/05/2026). Phoenix also takes petitions from outside the United States. Not the Vermont Service Center: that address (75 Lower Welden Street, St. Albans, VT) is only where a certifying official writes to withdraw or disavow a Supplement B (Supplement B Instructions 01/20/25, Part 6).
